limits: Ordered-edge equivalence preserves the original lexical display rules; it does not prove Lean elaboration or semantic completeness.
Nine alternating same-process pure measurements exclude JSON/native/browser preparation and rendering. The complete input, output length and ordered output hash are retained.

Five complete browser navigations per version/project use the same host/project/OS caches in a fresh context, normal motion, no throttling, CDP CPU sampling. DOM/two-rAF observations are proxies, not physical paint or field INP.
The resolver cache lasts only one complete immutable graph construction; changed symbol sets reconstruct their indices.
